label: Catalogue order from a supplier's shop
steps: Open the {shop} ({supplier}) from the catalogue and add what you need, up to {max_order}.
Submit the basket. It goes to your budget owner for approval.

label: Catalogue order of fixed-price items
steps: Submit. Standard items go straight through.

label: Existing contract: external workers
steps: The role profile goes to {supplier} under {contract_id}.
They shortlist candidates for you to interview.
Onboarding and system access follow after selection.

label: Existing contract: call-off
steps: A call-off is raised against {contract_id} with {supplier}.
The scope of work from this conversation is attached.
The contract owner confirms, then the order goes out.

label: Business-led demand
steps: You ask at least 3 suppliers for a quote{preferred}, using the service description.
Procurement checks the quotes and the supplier before you choose.
The purchase request is raised with the chosen quote attached.

label: Procurement-led demand
steps: Submit. A procurement-led sourcing project is created with the service description attached.
A buyer contacts you within 2 working days to plan the RFP and the evaluation team.
Risk, ICT and supplier checks run in parallel with the RFP.
